summary: 3D Bosphorus ferry-captain game, redesigned with golden-hour light, pastel yalıs and a navy-and-brass maritime chart UI, built by Claude Fable 5.1 · Boğaz'da 3D vapur kaptanlığı oyunu, altın saat ışığı, pastel yalılar ve lacivert-pirinç denizcilik haritası arayüzüyle yeniden tasarlandı, Claude Fable 5.1 yaptı
key_features: Ferry handling with throttle, rudder, current and wind; slide in to the pier at a shallow angle with the distance, speed and angle readout
Redesign: golden-hour default light, sunset-to-violet dusk, pastel yalıs, the white ferry with its yellow-and-black funnel
Redesign: a maritime chart UI with navy instrument panels, brass edges and a parchment route card
Shifts with fog, night, storms, tanker convoys and heavy traffic; passengers rate comfort and punctuality
Measured after the redesign: 60 fps on an Intel UHD 620 at 1280x720, 25 to 32 draw calls, 0 JS errors

social.headline: Captain an Istanbul ferry on the Bosphorus: keep the timetable and dock against the current · Boğaz'da vapur kaptanı ol: tarifeye uy, akıntıya karşı iskeleye yanaş
